text:
Situation: Metronidazole has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 57 months. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 8.2 to 30.4 days of supply. The Baxter Healthcare plant at FEI 1416980 (NDC 00338105548) received an OAI classification on 2026-04-02 and a Warning Letter on 2026-09-29. A second Baxter plant at FEI 2618677, also on the label, has a history of multiple OAI inspections and Warning Letters dating to 2010.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage posting for metronidazole dates to 2022-01-13 and is current as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection records show the FEI 1416980 plant received an OAI classification on 2026-04-02 and a Warning Letter on 2026-09-29. The FEI 2618677 plant has a record of multiple OAI inspections and Warning Letters since 2010.

Our position: We must secure supply from manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list while using the approved interchange for immediate needs. Hospira, Inc. is the preferred new source. The Sagent Pharmaceuticals interchange is already approved for clinical use.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hospira, Inc. (Infomed Fluids Srl, last inspection VAI 2023-04-07) — requires buyer approval.
2. Pharmacists to dispense Sagent Pharmaceuticals product (NDC 25021013182) per the interchange approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-03-29 — requires pharmacist approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Civica, Inc., and Henry Schein, Inc. as backup sources — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Continuing reliance on Baxter supply from FEI 1416980 or FEI 2618677 given their inspection histories.
